bibliographic.title: Unrequited
bibliographic.author: waltzofthedragons
bibliographic.description:
"Unrequited" is a short piece I wrote for the 2023 Anti-Romance Jam. It's about unrequited love and an aromantic person losing their best friend. It's also my first project made in Twine.
